verdict.rationale: Plaid is an API-first product. Its docs describe driving core functions through the Plaid API: Auth, Balance, Identity, Transactions and Payment Initiation. They also document a fully featured Sandbox that includes API-only endpoints like /sandbox/public_token/create, plus programmatic webhooks. An official Node SDK (plaid-node) shows calls such as transactionsSync, and an llms.txt is served for AI consumers. missing for 10: a machine-readable OpenAPI spec at the probed standard paths (all 404), independent hands-on corroboration of agent-driven API use.
